sources.snippet: These notes accompany the Stanford CS class CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision. For questions/concerns/bug reports, please submit a pull request directly to our git repo.

sources.snippet: Overview A small Mae implementation for Multitask, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The tiny variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: Stanford University CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
sources.snippet: You can build a new model (algorithm) or a new variant of existing models, and apply it to tackle vision tasks. This track might be more challenging, and sometimes leads to a piece of publishable work. One restriction to note is that this is a Computer Vision class, so your project should involve pixels of visual data in some form somewhere.
